People-capacity building
 Paul Njaga–(Group Chief Finance Officer) MBA Finance, University of Manchester
UK, Bachelors degree in Economics, Member of the UK Chartered Institute of
Securities & Investments (MSCI) and a CPA(K). Prior to joining Equity, he worked at
BNP Paribas as Director of Policy in London and as a Senior Manager with PwC UK &
Nairobi. Has 16 years experience
 Dr. Maurice Ewing –(Group Chief Risk Officer) PhD & Masters of Arts in Economics
from Princeton University, Bachelor of Arts in Mathematics & Economics from

Northwestern University (IL). Has 15 years experience in risk consultancy and is a
regular contributor to the Harvard journal.
 Collins Otiwu –(Finance Director) MBA Finance, University of Warwick, Bachelor of
Commerce from University of Nairobi, CPA(K) and a Certified Information Systems
Auditor (CISA). Prior to joining the bank, he worked at British Telecoms (BT) in
London as the Head of finance and treasury, British Petroleum (BP) in London as
Senior Manager, Policy and PwC UK & Nairobi. Has 14 years experience
 Henry Kimani –(General Manager, SME and Subsidiaries Credit) CPA(K), Member of
Institute of Risk Management of South Africa & South Africa Institute of Banking. Has
24 years banking experience. Prior to joining us Henry was Head of SME and
subsidiary credit for Standard Chartered in South Africa.
